title: Crescent Cove
summary: A crescent of palm-lined beach around a turquoise lagoon, with seagrass meadows, coral heads, a jetty and a rocky headland to climb.

shots.alt: Crescent Cove from the air: a palm-lined crescent beach and a rocky headland around a turquoise lagoon with seagrass and coral.
The cove on Crescent Cove: a canopied stone seat on a grassy rise among palms, with the lagoon beyond.
Low over the lagoon toward the palm-lined beach and the rocky headland.
From the headland summit over the lagoon's shallows and coral heads.

title: The Quiet Courtyard
summary: A walled courtyard of cypress, olive and plane trees around a stone fountain, with the cove's shaded seats at its gate.

shots.alt: The Quiet Courtyard from above: a walled garden of cypress and olive trees around a fountain, with a canopied cove at its gate.
The cove at the courtyard gate: a canopied stone seat in front of the walled garden.
The tiered stone fountain among cypresses and lamp posts.
The courtyard from its far end, over cypress rows toward the fountain.

title: Tidemark Island
summary: A quiet tropical island with open beaches, layered jungle, a thatched shelter and gently moving wildlife.

shots.alt: Tidemark Island from above: a palm-dotted beach curving into turquoise shallows.
The cove on Tidemark: a canopied stone seat on open sand, with palms behind.
Along Tidemark's shore, palms above a curve of sand and clear water.
Tidemark Island from the sea, a low line of sand and palms.

title: The Cove
summary: Every world starts from the cove and keeps it at its origin: a curved stone seat under a linen canopy, with a hearth, ferns and lamps, where you and your agent build.

shots.alt: The Cove: a curved stone seat with green cushions under a linen canopy on timber masts, ringed with potted ferns.
Inside the cove, the hearth stone on its round table under the canopy.
The cove's curved seat with green cushions and a red throw.
The cove from above: the canopy over the round floor and its inlaid rings.
